description: This file defines a utility enum `SimpleTaskSupport` with static methods for managing asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and starting a detached looping task.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new asynchronous task if none is currently running, executing the provided operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the current task if it exists and sets the associated task variable to nil.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached asynchronous loop task that executes the operation repeatedly at specified intervals until canceled.
